description:
Music to Release Tension | Soothing Strings | 1.5 Hours

If your shoulders are up around your ears and your jaw is tight — start here. The day's stress doesn't just sit in your head; it settles into the body and holds on.

Ninety minutes of slow, deep soothing strings to let that tension go — soft enough to feel your shoulders drop, your jaw unclench, and your breath slow down.

What you'll hear: deep, resonant strings with long sustained notes over a gentle drone — warm and unhurried, the feeling of the body finally putting down the weight it has been carrying.

Best for: unwinding after a long day · easing physical tension · before bed or a warm bath · a quiet room and a pair of headphones.

🔔 Subscribe to Raga Focus for Indian instrumental music to release tension, calm the body, and let the day go.
